revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 15.1% (478,834 vs 416,161, filed), FY2025 6.4%; growth assumed to fade from 7% toward ~4.5% as the base gets large.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: slightly below FY2026 filed margin of 33.0% (158,063/478,834); FY2025 32.0%, FY2024 31.5%. Held flat for conservatism.

tax_rate.source: Derived from FY2026 filing: (pretax 159,237 - net income 132,175)/159,237 = 17.0%, accession 0000320193-26-000026. Assumed to persist.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2026 filed D&A 13,423 / revenue 478,834 = 2.8%; held constant.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: filed capex/revenue was 2.4% (FY2024), 3.1% (FY2025), 1.9% (FY2026); 2.0% anchored on latest year, below the 3-year average of ~2.5%, a judgment that capex stays light.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par, 2026-11-06); ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16); unlevered beta cash-corrected 1.3246 (Damodaran US Computers/Peripherals, 2026-01-05) relevered at assumed D/E 3% (no share price available; filed debt 80.1B vs assumed equity value ~2.7T) and Damodaran-style tax 17% -> beta ~1.36; Ke ~10.9%; pre-tax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran industry), debt weight ~3% -> WACC ~10.7%. Conservative vs Damodaran industry WACC 9.7%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% 10Y risk-free rate (long-run nominal growth proxy) and in line with long-run US nominal growth less a margin.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 80,111 (LT debt noncurrent 68,208 + current 9,906 + commercial paper 1,997) - cash 36,305 - marketable securities 20,417; accession 0000320193-26-000026
